title: Settlement mints collateral at an unconstrained operator price with no oracle/signature binding and no aggregate conservation invariant
root_cause: SettlementTransLib.process credits collateral = syntheticBalance * settlementPrice where settlementPrice is a raw operator input (only 0..int128.max), not bound to the oracle/resolved outcome and not subject to any YES/NO conservation or reserve-backing check.
attacker_entrypoint: operator-submitted Settlement transaction with an arbitrary settlementPrice
attacker_capabilities: settlement operator chooses settlementPrice freely (trusted role)
out_of_scope_risks: relies on trusted operator behavior; programs may treat trusted-operator actions as out of scope

severity_justification.worst_case: Mis-priced/one-sided settlement mints unbacked withdrawable collateral that drains other users' deposits.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Missing on-chain invariant; impact bounded by operator honesty (no permissionless exploit).
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: L2: account holds synthetic 100, oracle price 1; operator submits Settlement{ settlementPrice=50 } (no oracle/signature/conservation check) -> collateralDelta = 100*50 = 5000 credited, synthetic zeroed
L3: other users fund LoadingZone (10000); attacker account deposits only 100, holds synthetic 100 (true value 100)
L3: operator settles attacker at 50 -> +5000 collateral; account owner withdraws 5000 -> 5000 real tokens leave LoadingZone to the attacker (reserve drops 5000; 4900 belonged to other depositors)

state_transition.before: attacker deposited 100; synthetic 100 (true value 100); LoadingZone reserve funded by other users
state_transition.after: synthetic 0, +5000 collateral minted, 5000 real tokens withdrawn; LoadingZone reserve drained by 5000 (net 4900 stolen from other depositors)

asset_delta: Proven end-to-end: 5000 real tokens drained from the shared LoadingZone reserve to the attacker; the attacker deposited only 100, so 4900 was other depositors' funds.
false_positive_risks: operator-trust-gated; program may treat trusted-operator actions as out of scope
invalidating_conditions: settlement price is validated against a signed outcome/oracle off-chain and the operator is fully trusted in scope

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: range check does not bind the price to the oracle/outcome and does not enforce aggregate conservation

assumptions: the operator can submit a settlement price not matching the resolved outcome
evidence_links: src/core/balance/LoadingZone.sol:processWithdraw (transfers real tokens from the shared pool)
triager_summary: Settlement payout = balance * unconstrained operator price, no oracle/signature/conservation binding. PoCs passing: L2 mints 5000 unbacked at operator price 50 vs oracle 1; L3 withdraws 5000 real tokens out of the shared LoadingZone (attacker deposited 100 -> 4900 stolen from other depositors). Trigger operator-trust-gated; reported Low (Medium defensible given proven fund loss).
vrt_category: Business Logic Errors: settlement payout not bound to oracle/outcome and no aggregate conservation invariant (operator-trust-gated)

cvss.aspect: Unconstrained settlement price -> withdrawable unbacked collateral drains other depositors
